stories.title: Colpita nave iraniana nello Stretto di Hormuz: un morto. Emergenza in Yemen: migliaia in fuga

en.title: Iranian ship struck in Strait of Hormuz: one dead. Emergency in Yemen: thousands fleeing
en.summary: Over 2000 people displaced toward Djibouti in 24 hours amid regional tensions. Saudi Arabia closed an oil pipeline while Iraq reopened border crossings with Iran, and regional leaders attended BRICS meetings in New Delhi.

stories.title: Accoltellamento in strada a Torino, gravi due giovani

en.title: Stabbing on street in Turin, two young people seriously injured
en.summary: An early morning stabbing in Turin's Aurora district left two young people seriously wounded, with a third person also involved but in less serious condition.

stories.title: Giorgetti: “Con l’aumento dei tassi tenere sotto controllo il debito. Flat tax? È sul tavolo”

en.title: Giorgetti: "With rising rates, keep debt under control. Flat tax? It's on the table"
en.summary: Italy's economy minister confirmed that a proposed 5% tax rate on salary increases for young people is under consideration and will be discussed by the governing coalition in budget deliberations.

stories.title: Kiev, drone russo colpisce stazione servizio al confine Ucraina-Polonia: "Russi alle vostre porte"

en.title: Kyiv, Russian drone strikes service station at Ukraine-Poland border: "Russians at your doors"
en.summary: A Russian drone attacked a service station near the Ukraine-Poland border. Zelenskyy challenged Putin to meet in December at the G20 in Miami and requested Patriot systems for air defense, while Ukrainian attacks targeted Russian regions.

stories.title: Kiev, 'colpita stazione servizio a confine Ucraina-Polonia. Russi alle vostre porte'

en.title: Kiev, 'service station hit at Ukraine-Poland border. Russians at your doors'
en.summary: Ukraine's Foreign Minister stated that a service station was struck near the Ukraine-Poland border, characterizing the attack as Putin's terror reaching toward EU and NATO borders.

stories.title: Giorgetti, con aumento tassi importante tenere sotto controllo debito

en.title: Giorgetti, with rising rates important to keep debt under control
en.summary: Italy's Finance Minister emphasized that maintaining market and investor confidence is necessary while managing debt levels amid increasing interest rates.

stories.title: I danni dell'attacco degli Houthi contro forze filogovernative in Yemen

en.title: Damage from Houthi attack against pro-government forces in Yemen
en.summary: Houthi-controlled media released footage documenting the results of attacks carried out against Yemeni pro-government forces.

stories.title: Iran, 'nave mercantile colpita nello Stretto di Hormuz, un morto'

en.title: Iran, 'merchant vessel hit in Strait of Hormuz, one dead'
en.summary: A merchant ship was struck in the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in one fatality and three injuries according to Iranian reports.

stories.title: OpenAI, Altman: nessuna quotazione in borsa, ora concentrarsi sulla sicurezza

en.title: OpenAI, Altman: no stock market listing, now focus on safety
en.summary: OpenAI's leadership has stated that the company will not pursue a public listing in 2026, indicating this is not the appropriate time for such a move.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina-Russia, news. Kiev: “Raid su treno al confine con Polonia. Russi alle vostre porte”

en.title: Ukraine-Russia War, news. Kyiv: "Raid on train at Poland border. Russians at your doors"
en.summary: Ukraine reported attacks on a service station and train at its border with Poland with no casualties reported. Russia indicated potential involvement of Xi and Modi as peace mediators.

stories.title: Kiev: “Raid su una stazione di servizio e un treno al confine con la Polonia. Russi alle porte”

en.title: Kyiv: "Raid on service station and train at Poland border. Russians at the doors"
en.summary: A service station and train were struck in attacks near the Ukraine-Poland border. The Kremlin noted that Modi and Xi have offered to mediate.

stories.title: Yemen, continua l’avanzata Houthi. Missili e droni contro una base militare saudita

en.title: Yemen, Houthi advance continues. Missiles and drones against Saudi military base
en.summary: An Iranian merchant vessel was rammed in the Strait of Hormuz resulting in one death and three injuries, with the crew evacuated.

stories.title: Progetti speciali e nuove giostre, Zamperla punta ai 130 milioni di fatturato

en.title: Special projects and new rides, Zamperla targets 130 million in revenue
en.summary: Zamperla, a company founded in 1966 that designs and manufactures amusement park attractions, aims to reach 130 million euros in revenue through new projects and rides.

stories.title: Stress emergente, l’Aidp in prima linea

en.title: Emerging stress, Aidp in the front line
en.summary: Aidp is addressing the issue of return-to-work stress, which remains under-explored in established workplace practices but is widely felt in companies. The organization has begun developing solutions to tackle this concern.

stories.title: Alberto Fassi: «Per fare impresa, non smettere mai di sognare»

en.title: Alberto Fassi: "To do business, never stop dreaming"
en.summary: Legami founder Alberto Fassi discusses his entrepreneurial vision and two special projects: the Dreamland natural park and the book "We are dreamers."

stories.title: Ex Ilva Taranto: piano governativo a fasi per gestire lo stop all’area a caldo e le ripercussioni occupazionali

en.title: Ex Ilva Taranto: government plan in phases to manage the hot area shutdown and employment repercussions
en.summary: Following a Milan Court of Appeal order issued on September 11, the hot section of the former Ilva steel plant in Taranto must cease operations by end of October, prompting a phased government management plan for the shutdown and its employment consequences.

en.title: Production advancing slowly in Lombardy
en.summary: Lombardy's economy showed industrial production growth of 0.1% on a quarterly basis in the second trimester, marking the sixth consecutive advance in an ongoing recovery.
